note: Live-session recording (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded. Passwords are never in this file: the owner types the connection string once when prepare asks (Server=10.50.0.30,1433;Database=master;UID=<login>;<the login's password entry>;Encrypt=yes;TrustServerCertificate=yes); prepare keeps it in the MG_SQL_BASE variable of this session and derives SQL_CONNECTION_STRING for each database; teardown removes both. T-SQL set-up runs on CON-SQL01 over PowerShell Direct as the lab Administrator with Windows authentication (SQL Server's own sysadmin group is Domain Admins). Episode login: lab_demo (db_owner in ContosoBikesApp).
prepare: $sql = { param($vm, $text) Invoke-Command -VMName $vm -Credential $cred -ArgumentList $text -ScriptBlock { param($t) $c = New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection 'Server=localhost;Integrated Security=SSPI;TrustServerCertificate=True'; $c.Open(); try { foreach ($b in ($t -split '(?im)^\s*GO\s*$')) { if ($b.Trim()) { $m = $c.CreateCommand(); $m.CommandText = $b; $m.CommandTimeout = 600; [void]$m.ExecuteNonQuery() } } } finally { $c.Close() } } }
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "IF SUSER_ID(N'lab_demo') IS NULL THROW 50000, N'Create the login lab_demo first (episode 3 demo.md, setup step 3; owner types its password off camera).', 1;"
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "USE ContosoBikesApp;`nGO`nIF USER_ID(N'lab_demo') IS NULL CREATE USER lab_demo FOR LOGIN lab_demo;`nALTER ROLE db_owner ADD MEMBER lab_demo;"
if (-not $env:MG_SQL_BASE) { $env:MG_SQL_BASE = Read-Host 'Connection string for lab_demo on 10.50.0.30,1433 (typed off camera, never saved; format in the note of record.json)' -MaskInput }
